HPO-ODS-W2-06.title: GOVERN_PRODUCT_MAIN_INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_RECONCILIATION
HPO-ODS-W2-06.rule: Manual conflict resolution on the merge of origin/main into codex/product-main-integration-r1 is authorized ONLY for the four paths named above, no wildcard. For .github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/scan-secrets.ts, resolution is INTENTIONALLY_REPLACED_BY_STRONGER_EQUIVALENT: take Product's version, which is a proven superset/convergence-target of main's. For docs/ops/CREDENTIAL_HYGIENE.md, resolution is a UNION: preserve every fact from both sides, add main's branch-scoped clarifications as additive paragraphs without deleting Product's more detailed per-file GH013 audit table, and correct only the minimum wording needed so a statement scoped to 'main' does not misdescribe the new integration branch it will also live on — no dates, incidents or dispositions may be invented or altered. For tests/scan-secrets.test.ts, resolution is a UNION: Product's file as the base (its import shape matches the resolved scan-secrets.ts), with main's one unique assertion ('does not exempt a path merely for being a test') inserted verbatim; no existing assertion from either side may be deleted or weakened to make the suite pass.
HPO-ODS-W2-06.non_vacuity_requirement: Post-merge, pnpm secrets:scan must still pass over the real repository (the suite's own 'passes over this repository' test exercises this), the DETECTOR union must still contain all seven kinds from both parents (mechanically the same set, confirmed identical pre-merge), and the newly-added 'does not exempt a path merely for being a test' assertion must be present and passing — proving the union is real, not merely asserted.
